n_or_bits.toy_scale_note: the construction result is size-independent; the two rungs are where the yield panel was measured

orbit_count_K.note: no orbit reduction applies to this base; K = |F| exactly, stated explicitly as the schema requires

materialized_note: toy cells materialise the base to run the exact enumeration; the construction itself is non-materialising and index-addressable at any size

construction_wall_ms.note: Python 3.12, one core; the structural saving is 3.3x fewer pair steps (Phi(B) vs B^2) plus no gcd and no hash set

retained_bytes_note: streaming generator is O(1); the naive equivalent retains an |X|-element hash set (8*|X| bytes)

index_addressable.method: rank = Phi(b-1) + #{a'<=a : gcd(a',b)=1}; unrank by bisecting the totient prefix and an inclusion-exclusion k-th-coprime search
index_addressable.use: shards a 10^12-element base with zero storage and no communication

resource_caps.peak_rss_note: single process; the 2^24 rung needs one |E|-sized uint32 array (67 MB)

seeds: splitmix64 seed 11 for the random shape; interval and Farey shapes are seed-free (canonical enumeration)
claim_boundary_non_claims: toy rungs only (20 and 24 bits); not secp256k1
no key recovery and no asymptotic sub-rho claim
no claim that any base shape or target statistic raises the expected yield
values are exact enumerations, not sampled estimates
